name: inventory
doc: Inventory keeps a catalogue of items, their stock, and the stock reserved for orders.

types.name: Category
types.doc: What kind of thing an item is.

types.name: Shortage
types.doc: Too little stock to reserve what was asked for.

types.name: Inventory
types.doc: The catalogue and the stock of each item in it.

funcs.name: Label
funcs.doc: The item as one line of text.

funcs.name: AddItem
funcs.doc: Add an item, or replace the one with its SKU; its stock is kept.

funcs.name: Receive
funcs.doc: Add received stock and return the new level.

funcs.name: Reserve
funcs.doc: Take stock for an order and return what is left.

funcs.name: Find
funcs.doc: The item with this SKU, if there is one.

funcs.name: StockOf
funcs.doc: The stock of an item; 0 for an unknown one.

funcs.name: ValueOf
funcs.doc: The value of the stock of every item in a category.

funcs.name: LowStock
funcs.doc: The SKUs whose stock is below the threshold, in no particular order.
